/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
search_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/ssg-pareek-search2.XXXXXX")
for spec in '"\\
  'S%20S%20G%20Pareek%20PG%20College%20Jaipur' \\
  '%22S%20S%20G%20Pareek%20PG%20College%22' \\
  '%22SSG%20Pareek%22%20Jaipur%20college'; do
  out=\""'$search_tmp/$(echo "$spec" | tr -cd '"'[:alnum:]' | cut -c1-30).html\"
  curl --insecure -L --max-time 20 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' \"https://www.bing.com/search?q="'$spec&count=20&setlang=en-IN" -o "$out" -w '"'%{http_code} %{url_effective}\\n'
done
python3 - \""'$search_tmp" <<'"'PY'
import sys, html, os
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.in_h2=False; self.cur=None; self.buf=[]; self.items=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,t,a):
        d=dict(a)
        if t=='h2': self.in_h2=True
        if self.in_h2 and t=='a': self.cur=d.get('href'); self.buf=[]
    def handle_data(self,d):
        if self.in_h2 and self.cur is not None: self.buf.append(d)
    def handle_endtag(self,t):
        if t=='a' and self.in_h2 and self.cur is not None:
            tx=' '.join(''.join(self.buf).split())
            if tx: self.items.append((tx,html.unescape(self.cur)))
            self.cur=None; self.buf=[]
        if t=='h2': self.in_h2=False
for fn in sorted(os.listdir(sys.argv[1])):
    if not fn.endswith('.html'): continue
    p=P(); p.feed(open(os.path.join(sys.argv[1],fn),encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read())
    print('---',fn)
    for tx,u in p.items[:20]: print(tx+'\\t'+u)
PY"

import sys, os, re, html
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.skip=0; self.parts=[]; self.title=False; self.in_main=0
 def handle_starttag(self,t,a):
  if t in ('script','style','noscript'): self.skip+=1
  if t in ('h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6','p','li','td','div'): self.in_main+=1
  if t=='title': self.title=True
 def handle_endtag(self,t):
  if t in ('script','style','noscript') and self.skip: self.skip-=1
  if t in ('h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6','p','li','td','div') and self.in_main: self.in_main-=1
  if t=='title': self.title=False
 def handle_data(self,d):
  if self.skip: return
  s=' '.join(d.split())
  if s: self.parts.append(s)
for fn in sorted(os.listdir(sys.argv[1]), key=lambda x:int(x.split('.')[0])):

 # print excerpt after last occurrence of page breadcrumb label? capture keyword hits
 toks=['BBA','BCA','BA','MA','BCOM','MCOM','BSC','MSC','MBA','MCA','Course Details','Program']
 hits=[]
 for pat in ['BBA','BCA','BCOM','MCOM','BSC','MSC','MBA','MCA','Bachelor','Master','Program']:

 print(fn, ' | '.join(hits), ' | ', text[0:700])
PY"
